extractedText: Home K-wave Jang Won Young of ”IVE” ranks 1st in the June girl group individual brand reputation rankings... 2nd place: Jennie of ”BLACKPINK”, 3rd place: Karina of ”aespa” Comment View Gallery (+3) Jang Won Young of the girl group "IVE" was ranked number one in the girl group individual brand reputation ranking for June 2026. On the 21st, Koo Chang-hwan, director of the Korea Corporate Reputation Research Institute, stated, "Individual girl group members in June 2026" According to a brand big data analysis regarding brand reputation, Jang Won Young of 'IVE' ranked first. Link analysis showed that she was rated as 'lovely, model, and controversial'. The Korea Corporate Reputation Research Institute announced that in June 2026, the individual girl group members ranked highly in their keyword analysis. To analyze brand reputation using big data, from May 21, 2026 to June 21, 2026, 119,608,637 pieces of brand big data for 735 individual girl group members will be extracted. Based on consumer behavior analysis of individual girl group members' brands, brand reputation is determined using participation index, media index, communication index, and community index. We calculated the index. The top 30 rankings for girl group individual brand reputation in June 2026 are: Jang Won Young from "IVE", Jennie from "BLACKPINK", and ae spa's Karina, BLACKPINK's Rose, RESCENE's Wonhee, ILLIT's Wonhee, BLACKPINK's Lisa, IVE's An Yu Jin, aespa's WINTER, LE SSERAFIM's Kim Chae Won, BLACKPINK's JISOO, NMIXX's Seolhyun, DIA's Jung Chae Young, Re d Velvet” JOY, “aespa” NINGNING, “Girls' Generation” Tae Yeon, “TWICE” NAYEON, “WJSN (WJSN)” YOUNG JI yeon, “TWICE” Jeongyeon, "cignature" Jiwon, "IVE" Lay, "ILLIT" Mocha, "RESCENE" Minami, "LE SSERAFIM" KAZUHA, "Girls' Generation" Yuna, "Weki Meki's Choi Yoojung, fromis_9's Lee Chae Young, Red Velvet's SEULGI, Red The analysis was conducted in the following order: "Velvet" IRENE, followed by "aespa" GISELLE.
